senses.en: An improvement or development in a particular field
Move forward or help something develop
Done or provided before a particular time or event

ex.en: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
ex.zh: 这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。

ex.en: Advances in renewable energy technology could reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve long-term energy security.
ex.zh: 可再生能源技术的进步可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并改善长期能源安全。

tip: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。

senses.en: using highly developed technology or methods
requiring knowledge or skills beyond a basic level
having reached a late stage of development or progress

ex.en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
ex.zh: 这台先进的相机即使在夜间也能拍出清晰的照片。

ex.en: Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
ex.zh: 先进的医疗技术可以改善治疗效果，但其高昂成本可能加剧医疗服务获取方面的不平等。

col: at an advanced stage｜处于后期阶段
tip: advanced表示先进或高级；预先通知用advance notice。

senses.en: a matter, event, or activity concerning someone
a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner

ex.en: The family picnic was a cheerful affair despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，这次家庭野餐仍然很欢乐。

ex.en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。

tip: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Very surprised by something unexpected.

ex.en: I was amazed to find flowers growing through concrete.
ex.zh: 发现花从混凝土缝里长出来，我十分惊讶。

ex.en: Researchers were amazed by how quickly children learned new vocabulary through interactive games.
ex.zh: 研究人员惊讶地发现，孩子们通过互动游戏学习新词汇的速度如此之快。

col: be amazed to discover｜惊讶地发现
tip: amazed描述人的感受；amazing描述令人惊讶的事物。

senses.en: To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.

ex.en: Those dripping taps annoy me when I try to sleep.
ex.zh: 我想睡觉时，那些滴水的水龙头让我心烦。

ex.en: Frequent online advertisements can annoy users and discourage them from returning to otherwise useful educational websites.
ex.zh: 频繁的网络广告会让用户感到烦躁，使他们不愿再次访问原本有用的教育网站。

tip: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。

senses.en: slightly angry about something unpleasant or inconvenient

ex.en: Leila looked annoyed when the printer jammed again.
ex.zh: 打印机又卡纸了，莱拉显得有些恼火。

ex.en: Residents often become annoyed when construction noise continues late into the evening without prior warning.
ex.zh: 如果施工噪声持续到深夜且事先没有通知，居民往往会感到恼火。

tip: annoyed形容人的感受；annoying形容令人恼火的事物。

senses.en: Worried or nervous about something uncertain.
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: I felt anxious while waiting for my exam results.
ex.zh: 等待考试成绩时，我感到很焦虑。

ex.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
ex.zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: separated by distance or time; not together
into separate pieces
except for something being considered

ex.en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
ex.zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。

ex.en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
ex.zh: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。

tip: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。

senses.en: To formally ask for a job, place, or permission
To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation
To spread a substance onto a surface

ex.en: Apply sunscreen before you go outside on sunny days.
ex.zh: 晴天出门前要涂防晒霜。

ex.en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
ex.zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。

col: apply for a job｜申请工作
apply to a university｜向大学提出申请
tip: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

senses.en: Feel grateful for something someone has done.
Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something.
Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.

ex.en: I really appreciate you watering my plants while I was away.
ex.zh: 非常感谢你在我不在的时候帮忙给植物浇水。

ex.en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
ex.zh: 政策制定者需要理解农村社区在获取医疗及其他基本服务时面临的困难。

col: appreciate your help｜感谢你的帮助
appreciate the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Someone whose job is to design buildings
Someone who plans and develops an important change or project

ex.en: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
ex.zh: 建筑师给我们看了未来新家的模型。

ex.en: Architects can reduce energy consumption by designing buildings that make better use of natural light.
ex.zh: 建筑师可以通过设计更充分利用自然光的建筑来降低能耗。

col: chief architect｜首席建筑师；主要设计者
the architect of reform｜改革的设计者
tip: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。

senses.en: The art and practice of designing buildings.
The style and appearance of buildings.
The way a computer system or other complex structure is organised.

ex.en: My brother studies architecture and builds tiny house models.
ex.zh: 我哥哥学建筑设计，还制作小房子模型。

ex.en: Sustainable architecture can reduce energy consumption by making better use of natural light and ventilation.
ex.zh: 可持续建筑设计可以更充分地利用自然采光和通风，从而降低能耗。

tip: architecture通常不可数；architect指建筑师。

senses.en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen.
The way objects are positioned or organised.
An agreement about how something will be done.

ex.en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
ex.zh: 我们安排了人来喂猫。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助父母兼顾工作职责与家庭生活的需要。

col: come to an arrangement｜达成协议
tip: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。

senses.en: how you think or feel about someone or something

ex.en: His cheerful attitude makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
ex.zh: 他乐观的态度让下雨的早晨也显得明朗起来。

ex.en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
ex.zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。

tip: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

senses.en: making you feel embarrassed or uncomfortable
moving clumsily or difficult to handle
difficult to deal with or manage

ex.en: There was an awkward silence after I forgot her name.
ex.zh: 我忘了她的名字，随后出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents manage awkward schedules without sacrificing their career opportunities.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助家长应对难以协调的日程，而不必牺牲职业机会。

col: an awkward question｜难回答的问题
tip: awkward可指社交尴尬，也可指动作笨拙。

senses.en: A formal dance style, or a performance using this style.

ex.en: My sister practises ballet at the studio every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每周六都在舞蹈室练习芭蕾舞。

ex.en: Public funding for ballet can help preserve artistic traditions and make performances accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 为芭蕾舞提供公共资金有助于保护艺术传统，并让更多观众有机会观看演出。

tip: 词尾t不发音；英式重音在前，美式在后。

senses.zh: 以（某事）为基础的；以；为重要部分（或特征；的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The way a person or animal acts.
The way something functions or reacts under particular conditions.

ex.en: The puppy's calm behaviour surprised everyone at the park.
ex.zh: 小狗温顺的表现让公园里的每个人都感到意外。

ex.en: Schools can encourage positive behaviour by establishing clear expectations and recognising students' efforts to cooperate.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过明确要求并肯定学生的合作努力，鼓励良好行为。

tip: 通常不可数；英式拼写behaviour，美式拼写behavior。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: take air into your lungs and let it out

ex.en: Sit by the window and breathe slowly for a minute.
ex.zh: 坐在窗边，缓缓呼吸一分钟。

ex.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

senses.en: A hard rectangular block used for building walls and houses.

ex.en: One loose brick fell out of the garden wall.
ex.zh: 花园围墙上掉下了一块松动的砖。

ex.en: Reusing brick from demolished buildings can reduce construction waste and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 重复利用拆除建筑中的砖可以减少建筑垃圾，并保留老街区的特色。

tip: 单块砖可数；作建筑材料统称时可不可数。

senses.en: A small booklet giving information about products, services, or places.

ex.en: I picked up a travel brochure at the station.
ex.zh: 我在车站拿了一本旅游宣传册。

ex.en: University brochures can help prospective students compare courses, accommodation options, and the facilities available on campus.
ex.zh: 大学宣传册可以帮助有意申请的学生比较课程、住宿选择及校园设施。

tip: 可数名词，常指介绍旅游、课程或产品的小册子。

senses.en: to put something in the ground and cover it
to hide or cover something beneath other things

ex.en: Our dog buried its favourite toy beside the fence.
ex.zh: 我们的狗把最喜欢的玩具埋在了篱笆旁。

ex.en: Instead of burying household waste, local authorities should invest in recycling facilities and public education.
ex.zh: 地方政府不应只是填埋生活垃圾，而应投资建设回收设施并开展公众教育。

col: bury your face in｜把脸埋进
tip: 发音同berry；过去式buried，动名词burying。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the grounds and buildings belonging to a university or college

ex.en: We found a quiet bench near the campus library.
ex.zh: 我们在校园图书馆附近找到了一张安静的长椅。

ex.en: Providing affordable accommodation on campus can help students spend less time commuting and more time studying.
ex.zh: 提供价格合理的校内住宿可以帮助学生减少通勤时间，增加学习时间。

tip: 表示“在校园内”通常用on campus，不加冠词。

senses.en: The leader of a team or person commanding a vessel.
To lead a team or command a ship.
An officer holding a particular rank in the armed forces.

ex.en: Our captain gathered the team before the final match.
ex.zh: 决赛前，我们的队长把全队召集到一起。

ex.en: A team captain can encourage cooperation by ensuring that every player feels valued and included.
ex.zh: 队长可以通过确保每位队员都感到受到重视和接纳来促进合作。

col: captain a team｜率领一支队伍
tip: 军衔含义随军种变化；海军中通常指上校。

senses.en: to shape wood or stone by cutting away material
to cut cooked meat into slices for serving

ex.en: My grandfather carved a little bird from soft wood.
ex.zh: 我祖父用软木雕了一只小鸟。

ex.en: Local artisans carve traditional patterns into wooden furniture, preserving cultural skills while creating products for modern homes.
ex.zh: 当地工匠在木制家具上雕刻传统图案，既保留文化技艺，也为现代家庭制作产品。

col: carve out a career｜开创事业
tip: carve强调削刻成形；carve out a career指开创事业。

senses.en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.

ex.en: We climbed the hill to explore the old castle.
ex.zh: 我们爬上山丘，去探索那座古堡。

ex.en: Restoring a historic castle can attract tourists while preserving valuable evidence of a region's architectural heritage.
ex.zh: 修复历史城堡既能吸引游客，也能保留体现当地建筑遗产的珍贵实物。

tip: castle中的t不发音；palace指宫殿。

senses.en: a competition to decide the best player or team
the position or title of being a champion

ex.en: Our school team reached the final of the championship.
ex.zh: 我们校队打进了锦标赛的决赛。

ex.en: Hosting an international championship can attract visitors, but the cost of new facilities may burden local taxpayers.
ex.zh: 举办国际锦标赛可以吸引游客，但新建设施的费用可能加重当地纳税人的负担。

tip: 既可指争夺冠军的赛事，也可指冠军头衔。

senses.en: To break rules dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage.
To deceive someone to obtain something unfairly.
A person who acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.

ex.en: My cousin cheated by hiding cards under the table.
ex.zh: 我的表亲把牌藏在桌子下面作弊。

ex.en: Schools can discourage students from cheating by designing assessments that reward original thinking rather than memorisation.
ex.zh: 学校可以设计注重独立思考而非死记硬背的考核，减少学生作弊。

col: cheat in an exam｜考试作弊
cheat someone out of money｜骗取某人的钱
tip: cheat someone out of something指骗走某人的某物。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An organisation that sells goods or services
The presence of another person or people with you

ex.en: My sister works for a company that makes bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家制造自行车的公司工作。

ex.en: A company that invests in staff training is more likely to retain skilled employees over time.
ex.zh: 一家愿意投入员工培训的公司，更有可能长期留住技术熟练的员工。

col: work for a company｜在一家公司工作
set up a company｜创办公司
enjoy someone's company｜喜欢与某人相处
tip: 表“公司”可数；表“陪伴”不可数。

senses.en: Try to win or succeed against others.
Take part in a sporting event or other contest.

ex.en: Several bakeries compete for customers on our street.
ex.zh: 我们街上的几家面包店都在争取顾客。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

senses.en: To give all your attention to a particular task.
To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there.
A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.

ex.en: I cannot concentrate with the television playing so loudly.
ex.zh: 电视声音这么大，我没法集中注意力。

ex.en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。

col: concentrate on a task｜专注于任务
concentrate resources on｜将资源集中于
tip: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

senses.en: To make someone unable to understand or think clearly.
To wrongly think one person or thing is another.

ex.en: These complicated instructions confuse me every time I cook.
ex.zh: 每次做饭，这些复杂的说明都让我摸不着头脑。

ex.en: Public health messages can confuse audiences when experts use technical language without explaining its meaning.
ex.zh: 专家使用术语却不解释其含义时，公共卫生信息可能会让受众感到困惑。

col: confuse A with B｜把A与B混淆
confuse the issue｜把问题弄复杂
tip: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Information in something, or the amount of a substance it contains
Happy with what you have or with your situation
To make someone satisfied with what is available

ex.en: The content of this podcast always makes me laugh.
ex.zh: 这个播客的内容总能让我笑起来。

ex.en: Schools should teach students to evaluate online content critically rather than accepting every claim as reliable information.
ex.zh: 学校应教学生批判性地评估网络内容，而不是把每一种说法都当作可靠信息。

col: content yourself with｜使自己满足于
tip: 名词重音在前，形容词和动词在后；目录用contents。

senses.en: The circumstances surrounding an event that help explain it.
The surrounding words that help explain a word or statement.

ex.en: Her silence made sense once I understood the context.
ex.zh: 了解背景后，我就明白她为什么沉默了。

ex.en: Historical events should be examined in their social context rather than judged solely by contemporary standards.
ex.zh: 研究历史事件应结合其社会背景，而非仅以当代标准评判。

col: in context｜结合背景；在语境中
tip: out of context指脱离语境，常用于断章取义。

senses.en: A narrow break in a surface or solid object
Break or cause something to break without completely separating
A sudden sharp sound, like something breaking

ex.en: There's a thin crack across my favourite blue mug.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的蓝色杯子上有一道细细的裂纹。

ex.en: Engineers discovered a crack in the bridge during a routine inspection and recommended immediate repairs.
ex.zh: 工程师在例行检查中发现桥梁有一道裂缝，并建议立即维修。

col: a crack in the wall｜墙上的裂缝
a loud crack｜响亮的爆裂声
tip: crack常指裂而未碎；shatter强调碎成许多片。

senses.en: an accident in which a vehicle hits something or falls
to hit something violently or fall and be badly damaged
to stop working suddenly or lose value very quickly

ex.en: Nobody was hurt in the crash outside our house.
ex.zh: 我们家外面的那起撞车事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Financial markets can crash when investors suddenly lose confidence in the stability of the economy.
ex.zh: 当投资者突然对经济的稳定性失去信心时，金融市场可能暴跌。

col: a stock market crash｜股市崩盘
tip: crash into后接撞上的物体；电脑崩溃也可用crash。

senses.en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money.
Recognition that someone deserves for an achievement.
A unit earned towards a qualification by completing coursework.

ex.en: We bought our new fridge on credit last month.
ex.zh: 我们上个月赊购了一台新冰箱。

ex.en: Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.
ex.zh: 成本可负担的信贷能帮助小企业投资设备，并为当地社区创造就业机会。

col: give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳
tip: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy.
Harm something or make it less effective.

ex.en: The storm caused serious damage to our garden shed.
ex.zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了我们花园里的棚屋。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
ex.zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the end of a person's or animal's life

ex.en: The old dog's death left the family deeply sad.
ex.zh: 老狗的离世让全家人深感悲伤。

ex.en: Improved access to clean drinking water has reduced deaths from preventable diseases in many communities.
ex.zh: 更便利地获得清洁饮用水，已减少了许多社区中可预防疾病导致的死亡。

tip: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

senses.en: A discussion in which people express different views.
To discuss a subject by considering different views.
To think carefully about options before making a decision.

ex.en: We had a lively debate about keeping pets indoors.
ex.zh: 我们就把宠物养在室内的问题展开了热烈讨论。

ex.en: The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.
ex.zh: 关于免费公共交通的争论集中在其环境效益和纳税人需要承担的费用上。

col: debate an issue｜讨论一个问题
tip: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

senses.en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The bakery delivers warm bread to our door every morning.
ex.zh: 面包店每天早上把热乎乎的面包送到我们家门口。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: the desire or need for particular goods or services
a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed
to insist on receiving something or require something essential

ex.en: Demand for cold drinks rises sharply during hot weather.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，冷饮的需求量急剧上升。

ex.en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
ex.zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。

tip: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

senses.en: a country in northern Europe, with Copenhagen as its capital

ex.en: My cousin moved to Denmark to study architecture.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到丹麦去学习建筑。

ex.en: Denmark offers useful examples of how cycling infrastructure can support healthier and more sustainable urban transport.
ex.zh: 丹麦提供了有益范例，说明自行车基础设施如何支持更健康、更可持续的城市交通。

col: the capital of Denmark｜丹麦首都
tip: 国名前通常不加the；丹麦人为Dane。

senses.en: Without being prevented or affected by something.

ex.en: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold wind.
ex.zh: 尽管寒风吹拂，我们还是散步散得很开心。

ex.en: Despite significant investment in public transport, many commuters still prefer driving because services remain unreliable.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通获得了大量投资，许多通勤者仍更愿意开车，因为公交服务依然不可靠。

col: despite the fact that｜尽管事实是
tip: 后接名词或动名词，不加of；接从句用the fact that。

senses.en: the place someone or something is travelling to

ex.en: We finally reached our destination just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我们终于在日落前抵达了目的地。

ex.en: Popular tourist destinations must balance economic benefits with the need to protect local communities and natural environments.
ex.zh: 热门旅游目的地必须在经济收益与保护当地社区和自然环境的需要之间取得平衡。

tip: reach a destination不加to；arrive at后接目的地。

senses.en: the firm intention to continue despite difficulties
the process of establishing a fact or making an official decision

ex.en: Despite the rain, she finished the race with determination.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，她仍凭借毅力跑完了比赛。

ex.en: Students who show determination are often better able to overcome academic setbacks and achieve their goals.
ex.zh: 有决心的学生往往更能克服学业挫折，实现自己的目标。

tip: 表决心常接to do；表确定常接of。

senses.en: A language variety used in a particular region or community.

ex.en: My grandmother speaks a dialect I sometimes struggle to understand.
ex.zh: 我奶奶说一种我有时听不太懂的方言。

ex.en: Schools can help preserve local dialects while teaching students the standard language needed for wider communication.
ex.zh: 学校可以在教授学生广泛交流所需的标准语的同时，帮助保护当地方言。

tip: dialect涉及词汇和语法，accent主要指口音。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.

ex.en: The news discussed economic problems affecting local shops.
ex.zh: 新闻讨论了影响当地商店的经济问题。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can support economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通能让劳动者获得更广泛的就业机会，从而促进经济增长。

tip: economic指经济方面的；economical指节约的。

senses.en: the system of producing, trading, and using goods and services
careful use of money, time, or resources to avoid waste

ex.en: Tourists support the local economy by shopping here.
ex.zh: 游客在这里购物，为当地经济提供支持。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can strengthen the economy while reducing dependence on imported fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以增强经济实力，同时减少对进口燃料的依赖。

tip: economic指经济的；economical指节省的、划算的。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication
someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound
software used to change digital content

ex.en: The editor suggested a clearer ending for my story.
ex.zh: 编辑建议我给故事写一个更清楚的结尾。

ex.en: A newspaper editor must balance the public's right to information with respect for individual privacy.
ex.zh: 报纸编辑必须在公众知情权与尊重个人隐私之间取得平衡。

col: editor of a magazine｜杂志编辑
tip: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity.
To be the same in quantity, value, or quality.
Someone with the same status, ability, or rights as another.

ex.en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
ex.zh: 我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的小块，分给大家。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that children from all backgrounds have equal access to quality education and essential healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应确保各种背景的儿童都能平等地获得优质教育和基本医疗服务。

col: treat as an equal｜平等对待
tip: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: something incorrect in an action, calculation, or judgement
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: An error in the booking left us without seats.
ex.zh: 预订出了差错，导致我们没有座位。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: To force out lava, ash, or gas from a volcano.
To begin suddenly with strong emotion, noise, or activity.

ex.en: We watched the volcano erupt in a nature documentary.
ex.zh: 我们在一部自然纪录片里看到了火山喷发。

ex.en: When volcanoes erupt, clouds of ash can disrupt air travel and affect communities far from the crater.
ex.zh: 火山喷发时，火山灰云可能扰乱航空运输，并影响远离火山口的社区。

col: erupt into applause｜突然爆发掌声
tip: 通常作不及物动词；erupt into后可接掌声等。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: added to the usual or necessary amount
more than usual, or in addition to the normal amount
an additional item, or a background actor in a film

ex.en: I packed an extra sweater because the evenings get cold.
ex.zh: 我多带了一件毛衣，因为晚上会冷。

ex.en: Schools should provide extra support for students who struggle to access learning materials at home.
ex.zh: 学校应为在家难以获取学习资料的学生提供额外支持。

tip: 形容词指额外的；pay extra中作副词。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To a very great degree.

ex.en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
ex.zh: 汤烫极了，所以我等了一会儿。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is extremely important for students who depend on online learning.
ex.zh: 对于依赖在线学习的学生来说，能够使用可靠的网络极其重要。

tip: 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词，语气强于very。

senses.en: something that influences a result or situation
to include something when calculating or making a decision

ex.en: Price was the main factor when we chose our sofa.
ex.zh: 我们选沙发时，价格是主要考虑因素。

ex.en: Access to reliable public transport is a key factor in reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 能否使用可靠的公共交通，是减少对私家车依赖的关键因素。

col: factor in the cost｜把成本考虑在内
tip: 动词常用factor in，表示把某因素考虑在内。

senses.en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs.
An animal or person of the female sex.

ex.en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
ex.zh: 母狮和幼狮一起在阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Encouraging female students to study engineering can help reduce gender inequality in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 鼓励女生学习工程学有助于减少科技行业中的性别不平等。

tip: 指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The condition of being physically healthy and strong.
The quality of being suitable for a task or purpose.

ex.en: Swimming every morning has really improved my fitness.
ex.zh: 每天早晨游泳确实提高了我的体能。

ex.en: Schools can improve children's fitness by providing regular opportunities for enjoyable physical activity throughout the week.
ex.zh: 学校可以在一周内定期提供有趣的体育活动机会，以增强儿童体能。

col: fitness for work｜工作胜任能力
tip: 不可数名词；fitness for表示对某事的适合程度。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a set of rooms forming a home within a building
level and smooth, without raised or curved parts
having too little air inside, especially a tyre

ex.en: We rent a small flat above a busy bakery.
ex.zh: 我们在一家生意兴隆的面包店楼上租了一套小公寓。

ex.en: Building affordable flats near public transport could reduce commuting costs for many urban workers.
ex.zh: 在公共交通设施附近建造价格合理的公寓，可以降低许多城市工作者的通勤成本。

tip: “公寓”英式常用 flat，美式常用 apartment。

senses.en: Able to speak or write a language easily and smoothly.

ex.en: She became fluent in Spanish after living abroad.
ex.zh: 在国外生活后，她能流利地说西班牙语了。

ex.en: Fluent speakers may still make grammatical mistakes, so language assessments should consider both communication skills and accuracy.
ex.zh: 说话流利的人仍可能犯语法错误，因此语言测评应同时考虑沟通能力和准确性。

col: a fluent speaker｜表达流利的人
tip: 说某种语言流利用be fluent in；流利不等于零错误。

senses.zh: 中学）九年级学生；（大学；一年级新生

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Feeling afraid because of danger or something unexpected.

ex.en: The frightened kitten hid behind the sofa during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，受惊的小猫躲到了沙发后面。

ex.en: Children who feel frightened in unfamiliar environments may benefit from patient support and predictable routines.
ex.zh: 在陌生环境中感到害怕的儿童，可能会从耐心的支持和规律的日常安排中受益。

tip: frightened形容感到害怕；frightening形容令人害怕。

senses.en: An empty space between things or within something.
A difference between people, groups, or situations.
A period when something stops or does not happen.

ex.en: The kitten squeezed through a gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 小猫从篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable education could narrow the gap between wealthy households and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 让更多人获得负担得起的教育，可以缩小富裕家庭与弱势社区之间的差距。

col: a gap in the fence｜篱笆上的缺口
tip: 两者间的差距用 gap between A and B。

senses.en: people born and living at roughly the same time
the process of producing something, especially electricity
a stage in the development of a product or technology

ex.en: Three generations of our family gathered for dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们家三代人聚在一起吃晚饭。

ex.en: Each generation faces different challenges as technological progress changes the skills required in the workplace.
ex.zh: 随着技术进步改变职场所需的技能，每一代人都面临不同的挑战。

tip: 表示“一代人”时可数；表示“产生”时通常不可数。

senses.en: Involving or affecting the whole world.
Considering all parts of something rather than individual details.

ex.en: Our teacher showed us a map of global temperatures.
ex.zh: 老师给我们看了一张全球气温分布图。

ex.en: Global cooperation is essential for tackling climate change because environmental damage rarely respects national borders.
ex.zh: 全球合作对于应对气候变化至关重要，因为环境破坏很少受国界限制。

tip: global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Moving or shaped in a smooth, attractive way.

ex.en: The swan made a graceful turn across the pond.
ex.zh: 天鹅在池塘水面上优雅地转了个弯。

ex.en: The bridge combines graceful curves with practical engineering, creating an attractive landmark for the city.
ex.zh: 这座桥将优美的曲线与实用的工程设计结合起来，成为城市一道亮丽的地标。

col: a graceful dancer｜舞姿优美的舞者
tip: graceful多形容姿态优美；gracious多指亲切有礼。

senses.en: someone who has successfully completed a university degree
to successfully complete a course at a school or university

ex.en: My sister graduated from university and started work nearby.
ex.zh: 我姐姐大学毕业后，在附近开始工作。

ex.en: Many recent graduates struggle to find employment that matches their qualifications in an increasingly competitive labour market.
ex.zh: 在竞争日益激烈的劳动力市场中，许多应届毕业生难以找到符合自身资历的工作。

col: graduate with honours｜以优等成绩毕业
tip: 名词尾音/ət/，动词/eɪt/；毕业于用graduate from。

senses.en: An informal word for a man.

ex.en: The guy next door helped carry my groceries.
ex.zh: 隔壁那位小伙子帮我提了买回来的东西。

ex.en: Calling a colleague a guy may sound friendly, but informal vocabulary is usually inappropriate in academic writing.
ex.zh: 称同事为guy可能显得亲切，但非正式词汇通常不适合学术写作。

tip: guy属口语；正式写作通常用man或person。

senses.en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.

ex.en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地体育中心练体操。

ex.en: Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.
ex.zh: 将体操纳入学校课程有助于儿童提高协调性、增强身体自信，并培养运动兴趣。

tip: 虽以-s结尾，表示运动时作单数：gymnastics is。

senses.en: An aircraft with rotating blades that can rise straight upwards.

ex.en: A helicopter landed in the field behind our house.
ex.zh: 一架直升机降落在我们屋后的田野里。

ex.en: A rescue helicopter can reach isolated communities when floods make roads unsafe for emergency vehicles.
ex.zh: 当洪水使道路无法供救援车辆安全通行时，救援直升机可以抵达被困的偏远社区。

tip: 乘直升机用by helicopter，中间不加冠词。

senses.en: a powerful tropical storm with extremely strong winds

ex.en: We stayed indoors as the hurricane approached the coast.
ex.zh: 飓风逼近海岸时，我们待在室内。

ex.en: Coastal cities need stronger flood defences and reliable warning systems to protect residents when a hurricane approaches.
ex.zh: 沿海城市需要更坚固的防洪设施和可靠的预警系统，以在飓风来临时保护居民。

tip: hurricane和typhoon均属热带气旋，名称因海域而异。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something

senses.zh: 使铭记；使意识到重要性
senses.en: to make someone understand how important something is

ex.en: Her homemade bread impressed everyone at the family dinner.
ex.zh: 她自制的面包让家宴上的每个人都赞不绝口。

ex.en: Applicants can impress potential employers by explaining how their practical experience matches the requirements of the role.
ex.zh: 求职者可以说明自己的实践经验如何符合岗位要求，从而给潜在雇主留下好印象。

col: impress someone with｜以……给某人留下好印象
tip: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to cause physical harm to a person or animal

ex.en: You could injure your back lifting that heavy box.
ex.zh: 搬那个重箱子可能会让你的背部受伤。

ex.en: Employers should provide safety training to reduce the risk of workers injuring themselves while operating machinery.
ex.zh: 雇主应提供安全培训，以降低工人操作机器时受伤的风险。

tip: injure通常指身体受伤；损坏物品常用damage。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

ex.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
ex.zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。

col: kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备
tip: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

senses.en: relating to Korea, its people, or its language
the language spoken in North and South Korea
a person from North or South Korea

ex.en: Our neighbour showed us how to make Korean dumplings.
ex.zh: 邻居教我们怎样包韩式饺子。

ex.en: Korean cinema has attracted international audiences, encouraging wider interest in the country's language and cultural traditions.
ex.zh: 韩国电影吸引了国际观众，激发了人们对该国语言和文化传统的更广泛兴趣。

tip: Korean可指朝鲜半岛两国，具体含义看语境。

senses.en: an old popular story that may not be historically true
someone greatly admired for exceptional achievements
a guide explaining the symbols used on a map or chart

ex.en: Grandma told us a legend about a sleeping dragon.
ex.zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于沉睡巨龙的传说。

ex.en: Local legends can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors interested in the history of a region.
ex.zh: 地方传说既能增强文化认同，也能吸引对当地历史感兴趣的游客。

col: a living legend｜当世传奇人物
tip: legend可能有历史原型，不等于已证实的历史。

senses.en: The size, extent, or importance of something.
A measure of the energy released by an earthquake.

ex.en: We only realised the magnitude of the damage at sunrise.
ex.zh: 直到日出时，我们才意识到损坏的严重程度。

ex.en: The magnitude of global food waste highlights the need for better storage systems and more responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 全球食物浪费的巨大规模凸显了改善储存系统和更负责任地消费的必要性。

col: the magnitude of the problem｜问题的严重程度
an earthquake of magnitude six｜六级地震
an order of magnitude｜一个数量级
tip: 谈规模常用the magnitude of；震级也用此词。

senses.en: very important, large, or serious
a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: The storm caused major damage to our roof.
ex.zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了我们的屋顶。

ex.en: Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.
ex.zh: 对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。

tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: a Southeast Asian country occupying parts of a peninsula and Borneo

ex.en: We explored a rainforest during our holiday in Malaysia.
ex.zh: 我们在马来西亚度假期间探索了一片热带雨林。

ex.en: Tourism in Malaysia creates employment opportunities, but protecting fragile coastal ecosystems remains an important priority.
ex.zh: 马来西亚的旅游业创造了就业机会，但保护脆弱的沿海生态系统仍是一项重要任务。

col: travel to Malaysia｜前往马来西亚旅行
Peninsular Malaysia｜马来西亚半岛地区
tip: 国名首字母大写，通常不加冠词the。

senses.en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm.
A male person or animal.

ex.en: The male duck has a shiny green head.
ex.zh: 这只公鸭有一个亮闪闪的绿色脑袋。

ex.en: Encouraging more male applicants to enter nursing could help address staff shortages and challenge gender stereotypes.
ex.zh: 鼓励更多男性申请进入护理行业，有助于缓解人员短缺并打破性别刻板印象。

col: male and female｜男性和女性；雄性和雌性
tip: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity

ex.en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
ex.zh: 金属把手摸起来冰凉。

ex.en: Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.
ex.zh: 回收金属可以减少采矿需求，并显著降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。

senses.en: the number equal to a thousand thousands

ex.en: The city now has more than a million residents.
ex.zh: 这座城市如今有一百多万居民。

ex.en: The government plans to invest several million pounds in renewable energy projects over the next decade.
ex.zh: 政府计划在未来十年向可再生能源项目投入数百万英镑。

tip: 具体数词后million不加s；millions of表示数百万。

senses.en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country
a group sharing a national identity, culture, or history

ex.en: The application form asks for my nationality and address.
ex.zh: 申请表要求填写我的国籍和地址。

ex.en: Access to essential healthcare should depend on medical need rather than a person's nationality or income.
ex.zh: 获得基本医疗服务应取决于医疗需求，而非个人国籍或收入。

col: people of different nationalities｜不同国籍的人
tip: nationality指国籍，不等同于出生地或族裔。

senses.en: connected with the place or language of someone's early life
living or growing naturally in a particular region
a person born in a particular place

ex.en: After years abroad, Ravi returned to his native city.
ex.zh: 在国外生活多年后，拉维回到了自己的故乡城市。

ex.en: Planting native species in urban gardens can support local wildlife and reduce the need for additional watering.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本土物种可以帮助当地野生动物生存，并减少额外浇水的需要。

tip: a native of指某地出生者；the natives可能带贬义。

senses.en: in a way that is easy to see or understand

ex.en: The puppy was obviously tired after its long walk.
ex.zh: 走了很长一段路后，小狗显然累了。

ex.en: Although renewable energy obviously benefits the environment, its initial costs may discourage investment in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源显然有益于环境，但其初期成本可能阻碍较贫困地区的投资。

tip: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。

senses.en: A group of people working together for a particular purpose.
The planning and arrangement of activities, people, or things.

ex.en: He joined a local organisation that rescues injured birds.
ex.zh: 他加入了一个救助受伤鸟类的当地组织。

ex.en: Effective organisation of healthcare services can shorten waiting times and improve access for rural communities.
ex.zh: 有效组织医疗服务能够缩短等候时间，并改善农村社区获得医疗服务的机会。

col: require careful organisation｜需要周密安排
tip: 英式常写organisation，美式通常写organization。

senses.en: plan and arrange an event or activity
put things into a clear and useful order

ex.en: We organise a picnic for our neighbours every summer.
ex.zh: 我们每年夏天都会为邻居们组织一次野餐。

ex.en: Local councils can organise community workshops to teach residents practical ways to reduce household waste.
ex.zh: 地方议会可以组织社区工作坊，教居民减少家庭垃圾的实用方法。

tip: organise常见于英式英语；美式通常写organize。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 收拾（行李）；包装；商品的）纸包；纸袋；大包

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An object or collection of objects wrapped or boxed together.
A set of services or measures offered together.
To put something into a container for sale or transport.

ex.en: A small package arrived at our door this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一个小包裹送到了我们家门口。

ex.en: The government introduced a support package to help small businesses invest in cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 政府推出了一揽子扶持措施，帮助小企业投资更清洁的生产方式。

col: a support package｜一揽子扶持措施
tip: 指邮寄的包裹时，英式英语也常用parcel。

senses.en: Clothing covering the legs separately, from the waist down.
Underwear worn around the hips and bottom.

ex.en: These pants have deep pockets for my keys.
ex.zh: 这条裤子的口袋很深，可以装我的钥匙。

ex.en: Some schools allow students to wear comfortable pants rather than requiring a traditional formal uniform.
ex.zh: 有些学校允许学生穿舒适的裤子，而不要求穿传统的正式校服。

col: a pair of pants｜一条裤子；一条内裤
tip: 美式指裤子，英式常指内裤；用 a pair of 计数。

senses.en: A narrow track for people to walk along.
The route along which someone or something moves.
A way of achieving something or developing over time.

ex.en: We followed a narrow path down to the beach.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走向海滩。

ex.en: Access to affordable education can provide a path out of poverty for disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的教育可以为弱势社区提供一条摆脱贫困的道路。

col: a path to success｜通往成功的道路
tip: 表示实现目标的途径，用a path to，to后接名词。

senses.en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.

ex.en: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
ex.zh: 我买新冬衣时省了百分之二十的钱。

ex.en: Nearly forty percent of surveyed residents supported investing more public money in cycling infrastructure.
ex.zh: 近百分之四十的受访居民支持将更多公共资金投入自行车基础设施。

col: a five percent increase｜百分之五的增长
tip: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines

ex.en: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
ex.zh: 开车进山前，我们停车加了汽油。

ex.en: Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.
ex.zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者乘坐公共交通，而不是开车上班。

col: run out of petrol｜汽油用尽
tip: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。

senses.zh: 停止：戒掉；离开（工作职位、学校等

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to identify someone or something known from before
to accept or understand that something is true or important
to officially accept something or honour someone's achievements

ex.en: I recognised your brother immediately, despite his new haircut.
ex.zh: 虽然你哥哥换了发型，我还是立刻认出了他。

ex.en: Schools increasingly recognise that regular physical activity can improve both students' health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 学校日益认识到，经常运动能够改善学生的健康状况和学习表现。

col: recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: recognise 常见于英式英语；美式多用 recognize。

senses.en: mention someone or something, or have them as the meaning
look at a source to find information
send someone or something elsewhere for expert help or consideration

ex.en: Please refer to the map inside your guidebook.
ex.zh: 请查阅你的旅行指南里的地图。

ex.en: Doctors may refer patients to specialists when their symptoms require more detailed investigation or treatment.
ex.zh: 当患者的症状需要更详细的检查或治疗时，医生可能会将其转诊给专科医生。

col: refer to a report｜查阅或提及报告
refer to something as｜将某物称为
refer someone to a specialist｜将某人转诊给专科医生
tip: 常接to；过去式referred，分词referring。

senses.en: a mention of someone or something
consultation for information, or a source used in writing
a recommendation or someone who recommends you for work

ex.en: Her speech included a warm reference to her grandmother.
ex.zh: 她在演讲中温情地提到了祖母。

ex.en: Academic essays should include accurate references so readers can locate the original sources of information.
ex.zh: 学术文章应包含准确的引文出处，以便读者找到信息的原始来源。

tip: reference to表示提及；for reference表示供参考。

senses.en: To think of someone or something in a particular way.
Respect for someone or attention to something.
Friendly greetings sent to someone, expressed in the plural.

ex.en: I regard this little café as my second home.
ex.zh: 我把这家小咖啡馆当作自己的第二个家。

ex.en: Policymakers increasingly regard access to reliable internet services as essential for equal participation in modern education.
ex.zh: 政策制定者日益认为，获得可靠的互联网服务对平等参与现代教育至关重要。

col: high regard for｜对……的高度尊重
tip: “把A看作B”用regard A as B，不用to be。

senses.en: To put information on an official list
An official list or record of people or things
To show or record an amount on a measuring instrument

ex.en: You can register for swimming lessons at the pool.
ex.zh: 你可以在泳池报名参加游泳课。

ex.en: Residents should be able to register for local healthcare services online, reducing unnecessary travel and administrative delays.
ex.zh: 居民应能在线登记使用当地医疗服务，以减少不必要的出行和行政延误。

col: register for a course｜报名课程
register to vote｜登记成为选民
register a complaint｜正式提出投诉
tip: 报名课程用register for；登记做某事用register to do。

senses.en: The process of officially recording details or joining something.
An official document showing that something has been registered.

ex.en: Registration for the swimming course opens on Monday.
ex.zh: 游泳课程将于周一开始报名。

ex.en: Online registration can improve access to public services, provided that support remains available for people without internet access.
ex.zh: 网上登记可以让公共服务更易获取，前提是仍为无法上网的人提供帮助。

tip: 表示报名或注册某活动，常用registration for。

senses.en: To have or establish a connection between things.
To understand someone's feelings through similar personal experience.
To tell someone about events or experiences.

ex.en: I can relate to your fear of flying.
ex.zh: 我能理解你对坐飞机的恐惧。

ex.en: Researchers should relate their findings to existing evidence before drawing conclusions about the causes of unemployment.
ex.zh: 研究人员在对失业原因下结论之前，应将研究结果与现有证据联系起来。

col: relate A to B｜把A与B联系起来
relate an experience｜讲述一段经历
tip: relate to可指“与……有关”，也可指“产生共鸣”。

senses.en: money paid regularly to use someone else's property
to pay to use something owned by someone else
to let someone use your property in exchange for payment

ex.en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
ex.zh: 我每月的租金包含水费，但不含电费。

ex.en: Rising rents in urban areas can force essential workers to live further from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 城市地区租金上涨可能迫使提供基本服务的劳动者住得离工作地点更远。

col: rent out a room｜出租房间
tip: rent可指租入或出租；rent out明确表示出租。

senses.en: an act of asking politely or formally for something
to ask politely or formally for something

ex.en: The hotel agreed to my request for extra pillows.
ex.zh: 酒店答应了我多要几个枕头的请求。

ex.en: Residents can request detailed information about proposed developments before local authorities make their final planning decisions.
ex.zh: 在地方政府作出最终规划决定之前，居民可以要求获取拟建项目的详细信息。

col: a request for information｜索取信息的请求
tip: 名词接for；动词直接接宾语：request information。

senses.en: The duty to manage something or answer for its results.
A task or duty that you are expected to handle.

ex.en: Feeding the dog is your responsibility this weekend.
ex.zh: 这个周末喂狗是你的责任。

ex.en: Governments and businesses share responsibility for reducing waste, but individuals also have an important role to play.
ex.zh: 政府和企业共同承担减少废物的责任，但个人也发挥着重要作用。

tip: 泛指责任常不可数；具体职责可数；后常接for。

senses.en: To study material again in preparation for an examination.
To change something to correct or improve it.

ex.en: I need to revise for my biology exam tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我得复习，准备生物考试。

ex.en: Governments should revise outdated housing policies to ensure that affordable homes remain accessible to young families.
ex.zh: 政府应修订过时的住房政策，确保年轻家庭仍能获得负担得起的住房。

col: revise for an exam｜复习备考
tip: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

senses.en: a return to activity, strength, or popularity
a new production of a play or other older performance

ex.en: Our local market is enjoying a revival this spring.
ex.zh: 今年春天，我们当地的市场又热闹起来了。

ex.en: A revival of traditional crafts can create employment while preserving skills that might otherwise disappear.
ex.zh: 传统手工艺的复兴既能创造就业，也能保留原本可能失传的技艺。

col: a revival of interest｜兴趣的重新燃起
tip: revival强调衰退或沉寂后重新活跃。

senses.en: to become active or popular again, or make something so
to regain consciousness or energy, or help someone do so

ex.en: Our neighbours hope to revive the annual street party.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居希望恢复一年一度的街头聚会。

ex.en: Investment in public transport could revive declining town centres by making local businesses more accessible.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地光顾当地商家，从而振兴衰落的城镇中心。

col: revive interest in｜重新激起对……的兴趣
tip: 既可及物也可不及物：revive a tradition；hopes revive。

senses.en: to damage something so badly that it loses its value
the remains of a building that has been badly damaged
the complete loss of money, success, or good condition

ex.en: Heavy rain ruined the picnic we had planned.
ex.zh: 大雨毁掉了我们计划好的野餐。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can ruin fragile natural habitats unless visitor numbers and construction activities are carefully managed.
ex.zh: 除非严格管理游客数量和建设活动，否则无序旅游可能毁掉脆弱的自然栖息地。

col: ruin someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip: 表示建筑遗迹常用复数ruins，如ancient ruins。

senses.en: a plan showing when activities or events will happen
to arrange for something to happen at a particular time

ex.en: My busy schedule leaves little time for cooking during weekdays.
ex.zh: 工作日里，我繁忙的日程几乎不给做饭留下时间。

ex.en: Universities should schedule examinations carefully to give students sufficient time for revision and recovery between assessments.
ex.zh: 大学应合理安排考试，让学生在各项考核之间有足够的复习和休息时间。

tip: 英音开头通常为/ʃ/，美音为/sk/；on schedule指准时。

senses.en: one of the two main periods of an academic year

ex.en: I'm taking a photography class at college this semester.
ex.zh: 这学期我在大学选修了一门摄影课。

ex.en: Offering work placements during the final semester can help university students move successfully into employment.
ex.zh: 在最后一个学期提供实习机会，有助于大学生顺利就业。

tip: 通常指一学年两学期中的一学期，不等于半年。

senses.en: Having a higher rank or more experience within an organisation.
Older than someone else, or relating to older people.
A final-year school or college student, or an older adult.

ex.en: A senior nurse showed me how to change the bandage.
ex.zh: 一位资深护士教我如何更换绷带。

ex.en: Senior managers should consult employees before introducing policies that significantly affect working conditions across the organisation.
ex.zh: 高层管理人员在推行显著影响整个机构工作条件的政策前，应征求员工意见。

col: senior to someone｜级别高于某人
tip: 比较级别用senior to，不用senior than。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Biological classification based on reproductive and other physical characteristics.
Physical activity involving sexual intimacy.
To identify the biological sex of an animal.

ex.en: The vet checked the sex of our new kitten.
ex.zh: 兽医检查了我们新养的小猫的性别。

ex.en: Researchers examined whether biological sex influenced participants' responses to the treatment in the clinical study.
ex.zh: 研究人员在临床研究中考察了生理性别是否影响参与者对治疗的反应。

tip: sex偏重生理性别；gender常侧重社会性别。

senses.en: A hard outer covering protecting an animal, egg, or nut.
To remove the hard outer covering of something.
An explosive object fired from a large gun.

ex.en: She found a tiny crab inside the empty shell.
ex.zh: 她在空贝壳里发现了一只小螃蟹。

ex.en: Rising ocean acidity can weaken the shells of marine animals, threatening their survival and wider ecosystems.
ex.zh: 海洋酸度上升会削弱海洋动物的外壳，威胁其生存以及更广泛的生态系统。

tip: shell作动词可指剥壳；shell peas是剥豌豆。

senses.en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed.
A collection of connected web pages.
Place or build something in a particular location.

ex.en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
ex.zh: 工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。

ex.en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。

tip: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。

senses.en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting
a single image or page shown during a presentation
a sloping structure that children slide down

ex.en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
ex.zh: 她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。

ex.en: Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
ex.zh: 教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。

tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为slid。

senses.en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.

ex.en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。

tip: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

senses.en: a way to solve a problem or answer a question
a liquid containing a substance dissolved in it

ex.en: Adding another shelf was a simple solution to the clutter.
ex.zh: 再加一个架子是解决杂乱问题的简单办法。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy offers a long-term solution to the environmental problems caused by fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源为化石燃料造成的环境问题提供了长期解决方案。

col: a solution to a problem｜问题的解决办法
find a solution｜找到解决办法
a practical solution｜切实可行的办法
tip: 表示“……的解决办法”用solution to，不用solution of。

senses.en: A place, person, or thing that something comes from.
A person or document that provides information.
To find and obtain something from a particular supplier.

ex.en: We followed the stream uphill to find its source.
ex.zh: 我们沿着小溪向山上走，寻找它的源头。

ex.en: Researchers should compare several independent sources before drawing conclusions about the effects of social media.
ex.zh: 研究人员在对社交媒体的影响下结论之前，应比较多个独立的资料来源。

col: a source of income｜收入来源
a reliable source｜可靠的消息来源
source materials locally｜在当地采购材料
tip: 来源常用source of；作动词可用source…from…。

senses.en: relating to one particular thing rather than things in general
giving exact details rather than general information
found only in a particular person, place, or thing

ex.en: Is there a specific colour you would prefer?
ex.zh: 你有没有特别想要的颜色？

ex.en: Governments should set specific targets for reducing air pollution so that progress can be measured accurately.
ex.zh: 政府应制定具体的空气污染减排目标，以便准确衡量进展。

tip: specific to表示“为……所特有”。

senses.en: A sculpture representing a person or animal.

ex.en: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
ex.zh: 喷泉旁矗立着一座马的铜像。

ex.en: Public statues can preserve local history, but communities should discuss which figures deserve such recognition.
ex.zh: 公共雕像可以保存地方历史，但社区应讨论哪些人物值得获得这样的认可。

tip: statue是雕像；status是地位，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: a refusal to work to demand better employment conditions
hit someone or something with force
occur suddenly to someone or create a strong impression

ex.en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
ex.zh: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。

ex.en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
ex.zh: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。

col: strike someone as unusual｜让某人觉得不寻常
tip: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

senses.en: To try very hard to do something difficult.
To fight or move forcefully against someone or something.
A difficult effort to achieve something or overcome opposition.

ex.en: I struggled to carry the heavy bags up the stairs.
ex.zh: 我费力地把那些沉重的袋子提上楼梯。

ex.en: Many young adults struggle to find affordable housing in cities where wages have not kept pace with rents.
ex.zh: 在工资涨幅赶不上房租的城市，许多年轻人很难找到负担得起的住房。

col: struggle to do something｜艰难地做某事
struggle with something｜艰难应对某事
struggle for survival｜为生存而奋斗
tip: struggle to do表示做某事很吃力，不保证成功。

senses.en: a short account giving the main points of something
presenting only the main facts or points

ex.en: Could you give me a quick summary of the meeting?
ex.zh: 你能简要说说这次会议的内容吗？

ex.en: A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.
ex.zh: 报告开头清晰的概要有助于读者迅速了解主要研究结果。

tip: a summary of后接概括对象；in summary用于总结。

senses.en: Liquid produced by your skin when hot or nervous.
To produce liquid through your skin.

ex.en: Sweat ran down my face during the steep climb.
ex.zh: 爬那段陡坡时，汗水顺着我的脸流下来。

ex.en: People who exercise in hot weather lose water through sweat and should drink regularly.
ex.zh: 在炎热天气里锻炼的人会因出汗而流失水分，应定时饮水。

col: break into a sweat｜突然出汗
tip: 汗水通常不可数；出一身汗可说a sweat。

senses.zh: 十几岁的（指；至；岁）；青少年的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A structure or underground chamber where a dead person is buried.

ex.en: We visited an ancient stone tomb outside the village.
ex.zh: 我们参观了村外的一座古老石墓。

ex.en: Objects discovered inside the royal tomb provide valuable evidence about ancient beliefs, craftsmanship, and social organisation.
ex.zh: 王陵中发现的物品为研究古代信仰、工艺和社会组织提供了宝贵证据。

tip: b不发音，与room押韵；常指有建筑结构的墓。

senses.en: Vehicles or systems used to move people and goods.
To move people or goods from one place to another.

ex.en: We rely on public transport to get around town.
ex.zh: 我们在城里出行靠公共交通。

ex.en: Better transport links between rural areas and cities can expand employment opportunities for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善乡村与城市之间的交通联系可以为当地居民增加就业机会。

tip: 上列为名词音标；动词重音后移，英/t/前为/n/。

senses.en: A device or concealed danger designed to catch someone or something
To catch or keep someone somewhere they cannot escape
A situation that deceives people or is difficult to escape

ex.en: We found a mouse inside the humane trap this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们在活捕鼠笼里发现了一只老鼠。

ex.en: High housing costs can trap families in poverty by leaving little money for education or training.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本使家庭几乎无钱支付教育或培训费用，从而令其陷入贫困。

col: fall into a trap｜落入圈套
tip: 动词过去式trapped、现在分词trapping都双写p。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To bring separate parts or groups together as one.

ex.en: The neighbourhood festival helped unify our divided community.
ex.zh: 邻里节庆帮助我们这个存在隔阂的社区团结起来。

ex.en: A shared public transport network could unify the region while improving access to employment.
ex.zh: 共享的公共交通网络既能将该地区连成一体，也能让人们更方便地获得就业机会。

col: unify different groups｜使不同群体团结
tip: unify强调把分散部分合成整体，可用于制度或群体。

senses.en: Unlike anything else, or the only one of its kind
Found only in a particular person, place, or thing

ex.en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern inside.
ex.zh: 每个手工碗的内侧都有独特的图案。

ex.en: Protecting local crafts helps communities preserve their unique cultural identity in an increasingly globalised world.
ex.zh: 在日益全球化的世界中，保护地方手工艺有助于社区保留独特的文化认同。

col: unique to the region｜该地区特有的
tip: unique to表示某处特有；严格指唯一时不用very修饰。

senses.en: the presence of different things rather than only one kind
a particular type of something

ex.en: We add variety to lunch with different colourful vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们用各种色彩鲜艳的蔬菜让午餐更丰富。

ex.en: Schools should offer a wide variety of activities to support students with different interests.
ex.zh: 学校应提供丰富多样的活动，以支持兴趣各异的学生。

col: a wide variety of｜各种各样的
a variety of reasons｜多种原因
tip: 多样性为不可数义；表示一种品种时可数。

senses.en: Official permission to enter or stay in a foreign country.

ex.en: My student visa arrived just before the flight.
ex.zh: 我的学生签证在起飞前不久才办下来。

ex.en: Simpler visa procedures can encourage international students to study abroad and contribute to local economies.
ex.zh: 简化签证手续可以鼓励国际学生出国留学，并为当地经济作出贡献。

col: apply for a visa｜申请签证
tip: visa是签证，passport是护照；通常需凭护照申请签证。

senses.en: The words someone knows or uses in a language.
The words used in a particular subject or activity.

ex.en: Reading short stories helps me build my English vocabulary.
ex.zh: 读短篇故事有助于我扩大英语词汇量。

ex.en: Students need a broad academic vocabulary to understand lectures and express complex ideas clearly in essays.
ex.zh: 学生需要掌握丰富的学术词汇，才能理解讲座并在论文中清晰表达复杂观点。

col: a limited vocabulary｜有限的词汇量
tip: 单个词用word；vocabulary通常指词汇总量或集合。

senses.en: A mountain with an opening that releases lava, ash, and gases

ex.en: We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
ex.zh: 我们望着湖对岸的火山，看蒸汽从山中升起。

ex.en: Although an active volcano can threaten nearby communities, volcanic soils often provide valuable land for agriculture.
ex.zh: 虽然活火山会威胁附近社区，但火山土壤往往能为农业提供宝贵的土地。

tip: 复数volcanoes或volcanos均可；喷发用erupt。

senses.en: to make a high sound with lips or escaping air
a small device blown to produce a high, clear sound
a high, clear sound made by lips, air, or a device

ex.en: My brother whistles cheerful tunes while washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我哥哥洗碗时会吹欢快的小曲。

ex.en: Lifeguards use whistles to attract swimmers' attention quickly when dangerous conditions develop near the shore.
ex.zh: 岸边出现危险情况时，救生员用哨子迅速引起游泳者的注意。

col: whistle a tune｜吹口哨哼曲子
tip: whistle中的t不发音；吹哨子用blow a whistle。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一上，来源：必修第一册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: completely or without any doubt
used to express strong agreement with someone

ex.en: The kitchen was absolutely spotless after we cleaned it.
ex.zh: 我们打扫后，厨房一尘不染。

ex.en: Reliable internet access is absolutely essential for students participating in online courses from remote communities.
ex.zh: 对于偏远社区参加在线课程的学生来说，可靠的网络连接必不可少。

tip: 常修饰essential等极限形容词，不常说absolutely good。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The opportunity or right to enter or use something.
A way of reaching or entering a place.
Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.

ex.en: Guests have access to the pool until sunset.
ex.zh: 客人在日落前都可以使用游泳池。

ex.en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会
tip: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: An extra item that adds usefulness to something
Something worn or carried to complement clothing
Someone who helps another person commit a crime

ex.en: This small camera accessory keeps my photos steady.
ex.zh: 这个小巧的相机配件能让我拍照时保持稳定。

ex.en: Consumers often replace electronic accessories unnecessarily, increasing waste and demand for raw materials worldwide.
ex.zh: 消费者常常在没有必要的情况下更换电子配件，增加了废弃物和全球对原材料的需求。

col: an accessory to a crime｜犯罪的从犯
tip: 配件常用复数accessories；从犯后常接to。

senses.en: to change behaviour or features to suit new conditions
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Our cat quickly adapted to life in the new flat.
ex.zh: 我们的猫很快适应了新公寓里的生活。

ex.en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

col: adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法
adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

senses.en: to accept that something is true, often reluctantly
to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution

ex.en: I admit that I forgot to water your plants.
ex.zh: 我承认我忘了给你的植物浇水。

ex.en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
ex.zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。

col: admit doing something｜承认做过某事
be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

senses.en: At a later time, following an event.

ex.en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。

ex.en: Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
ex.zh: 课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。

tip: 是副词，后面不直接接宾语；after可接宾语。

senses.en: A business that arranges services for people or other businesses.
An organisation responsible for a particular area of work.
The ability to make choices and act independently.

ex.en: The travel agency booked our flights and hotel.
ex.zh: 旅行社为我们预订了航班和酒店。

ex.en: A national environmental agency should monitor industrial pollution and ensure that factories comply with safety regulations.
ex.zh: 国家环境机构应监测工业污染，并确保工厂遵守安全规定。

col: individual agency｜个人自主行动能力
tip: 表示机构时可数；表示自主行动能力时通常不可数。

senses.en: relating to farming, including growing crops and raising animals

ex.en: The museum displays agricultural tools used by local farmers.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了当地农民使用过的农具。

ex.en: Modern agricultural practices can increase food production, but excessive chemical use may damage soil and water quality.
ex.zh: 现代农业生产方式可以提高粮食产量，但过量使用化学品可能损害土壤和水质。

tip: 形容词，常修饰 land、production、machinery。

senses.en: The activity of growing crops and raising animals for food.

ex.en: Many families here earn their living through agriculture.
ex.zh: 这里许多家庭靠农业谋生。

ex.en: Sustainable agriculture can protect soil quality while providing enough food for a growing global population.
ex.zh: 可持续农业既能保护土壤质量，又能为不断增长的全球人口提供充足的食物。

tip: 不可数名词；形容词为agricultural。

senses.en: something you want or plan to achieve
to intend or try to achieve something
to point something towards a particular target

ex.en: My main aim today is to tidy the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我今天的主要目标是把厨房收拾整齐。

ex.en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

col: aim to do something｜力求做某事
with the aim of｜以……为目的
aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

senses.en: Causing worry or fear that something bad may happen.

ex.en: The engine made an alarming noise as we climbed.
ex.zh: 我们上坡时，发动机发出了令人不安的声音。

ex.en: The alarming decline in insect populations could threaten food production and disrupt entire ecosystems.
ex.zh: 昆虫数量令人担忧的下降可能威胁粮食生产，并扰乱整个生态系统。

col: an alarming increase｜令人担忧的增长
an alarming trend｜令人担忧的趋势
tip: alarming形容事物令人担忧；alarmed形容人感到惊恐。

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.
A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.

ex.en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
ex.zh: 她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。

ex.en: Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.
ex.zh: 数字平台让独立音乐人无需依赖传统唱片公司就能发行专辑。

tip: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

senses.en: completely or entirely
when everything or everyone is counted
when considering everything

ex.en: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
ex.zh: 我们彻底不再去那家拥挤的咖啡馆了。

ex.en: Although online courses improve access, they cannot altogether replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程扩大了学习机会，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

tip: altogether是完全或总共；all together是全在一起。

senses.en: A senior official representing their country in another country.
Someone who publicly represents or promotes a group or cause.

ex.en: The ambassador welcomed visitors to the embassy garden.
ex.zh: 大使在使馆花园迎接了来宾。

ex.en: An ambassador can strengthen international cooperation by encouraging educational exchanges and maintaining dialogue during periods of tension.
ex.zh: 大使可以通过鼓励教育交流并在紧张时期保持对话，来加强国际合作。

tip: 驻某国大使用 ambassador to，不用 for。

senses.en: How much of something there is.
To total something or be equivalent to it.

ex.en: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
ex.zh: 往碗里加少量牛奶。

ex.en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。

tip: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

senses.en: Careful examination of something to understand its parts or meaning

ex.en: A soil analysis showed why my plants were struggling.
ex.zh: 土壤分析揭示了我的植物长势不佳的原因。

ex.en: Careful analysis of travel patterns can help planners design more efficient public transport networks.
ex.zh: 仔细分析出行模式可以帮助规划人员设计更高效的公共交通网络。

col: carry out an analysis｜进行分析
tip: 复数为analyses；英式动词为analyse。

senses.en: a family member who lived several generations before you
an earlier species or form from which something developed

ex.en: One of my ancestors built this old stone house.
ex.zh: 我的一位祖先建造了这座古老的石屋。

ex.en: Studying how our ancestors adapted to environmental change can offer insights into human resilience.
ex.zh: 研究祖先如何适应环境变化，可以帮助我们理解人类的适应能力。

tip: ancestor指祖先；descendant指后代。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To make information known publicly or officially.

ex.en: Our teacher announced the winners after lunch today.
ex.zh: 今天午饭后，我们的老师宣布了获奖者。

ex.en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
ex.zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。

tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。
教材补充词；首次出现于高一下，来源：必修第二册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To say you are sorry for something you have done.

ex.en: I should apologise for spilling juice on your jacket.
ex.zh: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，应该向你道歉。

ex.en: Companies should apologise publicly when their mistakes cause inconvenience or financial loss to customers.
ex.zh: 当企业的失误给顾客造成不便或经济损失时，企业应该公开道歉。

tip: 英式拼写；美式常用apologize，后接to人、for事。

senses.en: a formal request for a job, place, or permission
the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods
a computer program designed to perform particular tasks

ex.en: I sent my job application before breakfast this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早饭前，我提交了求职申请。

ex.en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
ex.zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。

tip: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

senses.en: to officially choose someone for a job or responsibility
to officially decide a time or place for something

ex.en: The club appointed my sister as its new captain.
ex.zh: 俱乐部任命我姐姐为新队长。

ex.en: Schools should appoint qualified counsellors to help students manage stress and make informed career choices.
ex.zh: 学校应聘任合格的辅导员，帮助学生应对压力并作出明智的职业选择。

col: appoint a committee｜任命委员会成员
at the appointed time｜在约定的时间
tip: 任命某人可用appoint sb as或appoint sb to职位。

senses.en: A way of dealing with a task or problem.
To move nearer to someone or something.
To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.

ex.en: We tried a different approach to training our puppy.
ex.zh: 我们试着用另一种方法训练小狗。

ex.en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
ex.zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。

col: an approach to learning｜学习方法
adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
approach a problem｜着手处理问题
approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
tip: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

senses.en: someone who studies past societies through objects and physical remains

ex.en: The archaeologist gently brushed soil from a clay bowl.
ex.zh: 考古学家轻轻刷去陶碗上的泥土。

ex.en: An archaeologist can reveal how ancient communities adapted to environmental change by examining tools and settlement patterns.
ex.zh: 考古学家可以通过研究工具和聚落分布，揭示古代群体如何适应环境变化。

col: a team of archaeologists｜一队考古学家
a leading archaeologist｜杰出的考古学家
a field archaeologist｜田野考古学家
tip: 考古研究人类遗存；研究恐龙的通常是古生物学家。

senses.en: the sport or skill of shooting arrows with a bow

ex.en: We tried archery at a supervised outdoor activity centre.
ex.zh: 我们在一家户外活动中心的指导下尝试了射箭。

ex.en: Offering archery in schools could introduce students to a sport that develops concentration and physical coordination.
ex.zh: 学校开设射箭课程，可以让学生接触一项培养专注力和身体协调能力的运动。

tip: archery 是不可数名词；射箭运动员叫 archer。

senses.en: An angry disagreement between people.
A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.

ex.en: We had an argument about whose turn it was.
ex.zh: 我们为该轮到谁而争吵了起来。

ex.en: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

col: a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据
tip: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

senses.en: to or at one side, away from the main position
away from current consideration or use
a quiet remark or comment outside the main conversation

ex.en: She stepped aside to let the cyclist pass.
ex.zh: 她走到一旁，让骑自行车的人过去。

ex.en: Governments should set aside sufficient funds for maintaining public parks, rather than focusing solely on new construction.
ex.zh: 政府应留出足够的资金维护公园，而不是只关注新建项目。

col: put differences aside｜暂时搁置分歧
tip: aside通常是副词；“除……以外”用aside from。

senses.en: To help someone do something.

ex.en: A friendly librarian assisted me with the printer.
ex.zh: 一位友善的图书管理员帮我使用了打印机。

ex.en: Local volunteers can assist older residents with online services, making essential information more accessible.
ex.zh: 当地志愿者可以帮助老年居民使用在线服务，让他们更容易获取重要信息。

col: assist someone with something｜帮助某人处理某事
assist in doing something｜协助做某事
assist someone to do something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: 比help正式；常用assist someone with something。

senses.en: To accept something as true without having proof.
To take on a duty, responsibility, or position.
To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.

ex.en: Don't assume the shop is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 别想当然地以为这家店周日营业。

ex.en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。

tip: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。
